language-development-milestones.alt: A timeline from birth to 30 months. Cooing at about 2 months ("ooh", "aah"); babbling at about 6 months ("ba-ba-ba"); the one-word stage at about 12 months ("Doggy!"); telegraphic speech at about 18 to 24 months ("Want juice."); sentences by about 27 months, often with overgeneralized rules ("I goed outside."). Ages are typical; children vary by several months.
